q.line: But you're at the bar or at Gene's

partner.line: And I still call you, but I get your machine

stanza: Coming down in smithereens

partner.line: On Staten Island, Bronx and Queens

q.line: You broke my heart into smithereens

I'm the one who always told you you were smart
You broke my heart into smithereens
